name: backup
label: Backup
tagline: Offline code, snapshots and the rescue drive

manifest.summary: Emerson's offline GitHub plus offline rescue: browses the bare git mirrors and the dated snapshots on the external backup drive (Rescue and Vault partitions), compares a snapshot file with the laptop, copies files back to ~/Restored, shows backup status with Back up now and Eject, and renders the restore guide.

features.name: Code
features.description: Every mirror in Vault/git: branches, tags, history, a commit's diff, the file tree and files at any commit, README rendered. Read-only git plumbing.

features.name: Snapshots
features.description: Rescue or Vault, a set, a date: browse, view text and pictures, compare with the live copy, copy a file or folder to ~/Restored/<date>/ (never over anything).

features.name: Status
features.description: Drive plugged in, free space, every set's snapshots and age, due or not, last run; Back up now (systemd units via polkit) with the live journal; Eject.

manifest.data_dir: reads the drive (/mnt/forge-drive or /run/media/ejb/{Rescue,Vault}); writes only ~/Restored
known_gaps: Root-owned Rescue folders show 'needs admin'; no sudo helper
No search across a snapshot or a repo yet
